PRIVACY

Practice stays on your device.

Last updated 25 October 2026.

Simulator data.

The application does not require an account and does not send game scores, penalty entries, tutorial completion or test results to an application database. Those values are held in the current page’s memory and reset when you reload or close it. First-shift notes and report drafts are also kept in the page until you navigate away.

The application code does not add advertising pixels, behavioural analytics or application cookies. Controller reference images used in the library are served with the site. Optional external reference images and manuals may contact the third-party host when opened or loaded.

Hosting and security services.

This static site is hosted using OpenAI Sites and delivered through Cloudflare. Those providers receive normal web requests, which can include IP address, browser information, requested URL and timing. The delivery layer may set security or bot-management cookies. Their processing and retention are governed by their own policies; we do not claim that visiting this site produces no server logs.

OpenAI privacy policy · Cloudflare privacy policy

GitHub reports and external links.

The Contact page builds a report draft in your browser. Nothing is submitted by that form. Choosing “Review on GitHub” puts the draft in a GitHub issue URL so you can edit and submit it there; GitHub receives that URL and its contents. A submitted issue is public. Do not include player details, passwords, private contact information or photos of children.

External manuals and organization links have their own privacy policies. To request a correction or discuss this page, use Contact. For removal of information posted in a GitHub issue, contact the repository maintainer through that issue or GitHub support.
